notes.gold: The single --stage-gold spend is the ₪340 missed-savings payoff at FOX - פוקס (קטגוריית ביגוד ואביזרים): the in-phone figure stays on the app's own foreground ink (no in-screen gold), and the stage gold glow blooms to 0.62 at 3.80s then settles to 0.30 by 5.75s — the glow reacts to the payoff, it never idles.
notes.staged_reveals: Where the camera used to own time, content does: tab A's spend card reads out 1.58-4.28s with the ₪340 counted rather than announced (3.00-3.85s), tab B's slide head + period selector 4.56-5.64s, the reserved certainty track at 5.84s, the band card and the matched-store card 6.20-12.06s (store, purchase count, payment method, then BOTH matched shops beneath), the stage's certainty line at 11.20s, stillness, then the trio. No idle loop, no breathe, no float.
